readme: Player name (no diacritics, no punctuation, lower case) to the file stem of his headshot in jsierrahoopshype/nba-headshots. 'faces' are in players/headshots/face2-160 as .webp, 'fallback' only in players/headshots/face as .png. Anything missing gets fallbacks/player_silhouette.svg. Refresh with scripts/fetch_headshot_ids.py.
